# Riders Geo / Wifiyka

An open-source geographic PWA with a working Wi-Fi map, preloaded PMTiles maps,
local edits and durable synchronization. Hotel/campus/park applications are
adaptation scenarios; indoor positioning and floor routing are not implemented.

## Documentation

- [Product and architecture](https://wifi.eval.su/tech)
- [API documentation](https://wifi.eval.su/api-docs.html)
- [OpenAPI contract](https://wifi.eval.su/openapi.yaml)
- [Source and deployment](https://github.com/sergey-from-riders/waifaika)
